principles: Fix only the observed DONE gate correctness gap.
Keep materialOverlapAudit inside the signed gate decision input before signing.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for real overlaps.
Do not create new server or command submission surfaces.
drivers: Staging live DONE preflight blocks with materialOverlapAudit.present=false.
Server already has a clear /v1/gates/evaluate signed decision contract.
CLI must remain host-neutral and receipt-driven.

options.name: A: Add materialOverlapAudit to CLI gate request contract and signed envelope
pros: Keeps receipt proof input digest semantics correct.
cons: Requires touching both general gate path and live smoke path.
Real changedFiles source remains a later parallel-flow integration concern.

options.name: B: Add a separate CLI command/check submission path for material overlap audit
pros: Could feel explicit from a user-flow perspective.
cons: Contradicts current Server gate consumption logic.
Would duplicate or invent an unsupported API contract.
Would not fix present=false unless Server behavior also changed.

options.name: C: Disable or bypass DONE materialOverlapAudit in the smoke
pros: Fastest way to make the smoke move past preflight.
cons: Would allow claiming DONE without satisfying the Server policy.

chosen: A: Add materialOverlapAudit to CLI gate request contract and signed envelope
rationale: Option A directly fixes the actual mismatch: the Server expects materialOverlapAudit inside the signed /v1/gates/evaluate decision input, while the CLI currently omits it. It is the smallest consistent change and preserves Authority receipt semantics.

preMortem.scenario: The CLI adds materialOverlapAudit after signing or outside decision.
preMortem.trigger: Envelope construction appends the field in a wrapper object instead of the canonical decision payload.
preMortem.consequence: Server still reports present=false or signature/digest verification diverges.
preMortem.mitigation: Add envelope regression coverage that inspects signed request decision.materialOverlapAudit before verification/build output.

preMortem.scenario: The smoke passes by clearing real overlaps.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation normalizes any actualFileOverlaps value to an empty array for DONE.
preMortem.consequence: A real material conflict could be hidden and Authority DONE would no longer fail closed.
preMortem.mitigation: Add negative coverage proving non-empty actualFileOverlaps is preserved in the request/envelope.

preMortem.scenario: Only the live smoke is fixed, but the general Authority gate path still omits the audit.
preMortem.trigger: Patch touches authority-live-python-e2e-smoke.ts but not authority-client.ts or gate contract types.
preMortem.consequence: Manual smoke succeeds while real CLI Authority job flows still fail DONE preflight.
preMortem.mitigation: Update GateEvaluateRequestContract and buildGateEvaluateEnvelope, then test the general request/envelope builder path.

preMortem.scenario: The story expands into Server endpoint or lifecycle redesign work.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation follows failed /v1/checks or /v1/commands attempts instead of the signed gate contract.
preMortem.consequence: Scope grows and may create a second unsupported contract that conflicts with Server policy.
preMortem.mitigation: Use the scope boundary and handoff doc as source of truth; reject new endpoint/command surfaces in review.
